verdict.rationale: Anomaly and duplicate monitoring is a fair question for bookkeeping software, so the axis applies. The pack shows no agent or feature that flags spend anomalies or duplicate transactions. 'See when receipts are missing' and booking-category suggestions are adjacent features, and the REST API and OpenAPI spec are only developer building blocks for building such monitoring.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor the ledger and flag anomalies in spend or duplicate transactions before the close
